subject: financial_literacy
concept: Balancing a checkbook: comparing a checkbook register to a bank statement to confirm they match
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student checks off matching transactions between a sample register and a sample bank statement
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies a transaction present on one document but missing from the other
exercise.abstract: Student reconciles a checkbook register against a bank statement and explains any discrepancy found

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly identifies whether the register and statement match, and if not, identifies the specific discrepancy
misconception_flags: declares the accounts balanced without actually checking every transaction against both documents

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
